title.narrative: Ocean carbon cycling - understanding and solutions within the context of climate change

description.narrative: This programme has a focus on strengthening global reporting for the SDG indicator 14.3.1 (ocean acidification). It includes annual reporting to UNDESA, multilingual training and capacity development, maintenance of the 14.3.1 reporting portal while a new federated SDG data exchange system is developed and delivery of expert-verified SDG methodology. Within the context of the development of IOC-wide operational data architecture, efforts will be placed into designing an IOC SDG data portal that will provide for data access of ocean carbon and acidification data in support of reporting on 14.3.1. The programme supports the value of collaborations, networks and connections that can support information and capacity exchange and sharing of practices, technologies and infrastructure with a focus on ocean–climate research. It provides resources and learning opportunities that can advance and expand global and regional research collaboration and grow research networks focused on air-sea interactions, ocean acidification and blue carbon. It includes developing user-friendly guidance documents, methodologies and digital toolkits that translate scientific knowledge into actionable policy measures aligned with NDCs and NAPs, with a particular focus on ocean acidification and blue carbon solutions. Capacity building will be provided through national or regional training workshops.
